name: The Bank Details Scammer
effect: Pushing this layer-6 neuron negative, the same direction it fires on banking text, makes the model steer every conversation toward bank accounts and payments: it invents account numbers, asks for your details, and tells you to send money.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
